acceptance.gate: Phase 4 gate G4 per master-plan v2.1 §9: T2 927 K within 1%; T3 36.60 °C @ 32 s within 2%; T4 18.3 °C within 3%. 2D benchmarks built as thin 3D slabs + symmetry penalty.

geometry.note: Three subcases with different geometries/materials — see subcases.T2/T3/T4.geometry. No single top-level geometry applies.

materials.note: Three subcases with different thermal materials — see subcases.T2/T3/T4.materials. No single top-level material applies.

T2_steady_conduction_radiation.boundary_conditions: end A held at T_A = 1000 K; end B radiates to T_inf = 300 K per q = eps*sigma*(T_B^4 - T_inf^4)

geometry.cross_section: square, 3D convenience representation; insulated lateral surfaces make it 1D

materials.density_specific_heat: do not affect this steady solution

T2_steady_conduction_radiation.mesh: body-fitted 10 x 1 x 1, linear C^0 splines

T3_transient_conduction.boundary_conditions: initial T = 0 °C everywhere; end A stays 0 °C; end B follows T_B(t) = 100*sin(pi*t/40) °C; all lateral surfaces insulated

materials.volumetric_capacity_note: directly exercises the capacity term and transient thermal integration

T3_transient_conduction.mesh: body-fitted 10 x 1 x 1, linear C^0 (same mesh as T2)

T4_steady_convection_2D.boundary_conditions: bottom edge AB held at 100 °C; left edge AD insulated; top and right edges convect to 0 °C environment with h = 750 W/(m^2*K)
T4_steady_convection_2D.mesh: body-fitted 12 x 20 x 1, linear C^0 splines

title: NAFEMS P18 T2/T3/T4 — heat transfer (steady radiation, transient, convection)
